raw_text: Protests erupted across Iran on the first anniversary of Mahsa Jina Amini's death in morality police custody. Despite a massive security deployment, demonstrations were reported in Tehran, Isfahan, Shiraz, Sanandaj, and Tabriz. The authorities shut down mobile internet in multiple provinces and deployed plainclothes agents in university campuses. International solidarity rallies drew thousands in European and North American cities.
